meta.scope: Taiwan Batch 2 — Semiconductor / industrial uniqueness, demographic extremes (ultra-low fertility + super-aged status), key trade agreements (ECFA, ANZTEC, ASTEP and network overview), and supporting structural series. Explicit referenced_by lists written to support strong edge formation under the force layout.
meta.strategy_note: Addresses the live-graph reality: Asia is currently thin (only 4 nodes visible). High-authority, high-citation nodes with clear dependency chains are prioritised so the 3D force structure can develop proper clusters once Claude verifies and the data is loaded.

candidates.title: Semiconductor / IC industry production and structure statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / Taiwan Semiconductor Industry Association / related official sources
candidates.description: Official and industry-linked statistics on IC design, wafer foundry, IDM and packaging/testing output, global market shares, and contribution to industrial production and exports. Taiwan holds global #1 positions in pure-play foundry and OSAT and a very high share of advanced-node capacity.
referenced_by: Industrial Production Index (electronics and electronic parts components dominate recent growth)
Customs trade statistics (semiconductor and ICT export shares)
National accounts industry detail and export-led growth analysis
CBC and external-sector commentary on technology export performance
candidates.notes: Highest-uniqueness industrial node for Taiwan. Foundry market share ~60 %+ and advanced packaging leadership create a structural dependency that pulls industrial production, trade, BOP goods, and investment statistics into a tight cluster. Essential for force-layout cluster formation around technology/manufacturing.

candidates.title: Vital Statistics — births, total fertility rate, crude birth rate
candidates.description: Annual and monthly vital statistics on live births, crude birth rate and total fertility rate. Taiwan has recorded one of the world’s lowest fertility rates (recent crude birth rate ~4.6 per 1,000; TFR well below replacement and recently the lowest globally in some readings).
referenced_by: Super-aged society indicators and long-term care planning
candidates.notes: Demographic uniqueness parallel to (and in some metrics more extreme than) Korea. Creates strong edges into population, ageing, labour supply and social-policy nodes.

candidates.title: Super-aged society indicators (65+ share ≥ 20 %)
candidates.description: Official tracking of the share of population aged 65 and over. Taiwan crossed the 20 % threshold and is formally a super-aged society under UN criteria. Accompanied by rising old-age dependency and declining youth share.
candidates.notes: High-authority demographic status node. Links tightly to fertility, population projections and social-protection series — the same cluster pattern that strengthens Japan and Korea force structures.

candidates.title: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA)
candidates.publisher: Republic of China (Taiwan) / People’s Republic of China
candidates.description: Framework agreement signed 2010 that established preferential trade arrangements across the Taiwan Strait. Early harvest lists and subsequent follow-on negotiations have structured a significant portion of cross-strait goods trade. Continuously cited in trade statistics and policy debate.
referenced_by: Customs trade statistics by partner (China share)
Industrial and investment analysis of cross-strait supply chains
Subsequent cross-strait economic policy documents and impact assessments
candidates.notes: Unique and high-citation agreement node. Because China is a major trade partner, ECFA creates strong edges into trade statistics, industrial production (especially intermediate goods) and investment flows. Critical for the Taiwan cluster’s external dimension.

candidates.title: Agreement between New Zealand and the Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu on Economic Cooperation (ANZTEC)
candidates.description: Comprehensive economic cooperation agreement that entered into force in 2013. One of the higher-quality bilateral instruments Taiwan has concluded with a developed economy.
candidates.notes: High-standard bilateral FTA. Supports the trade-agreement cluster.

candidates.title: Agreement between Singapore and the Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu on Economic Partnership (ASTEP)
candidates.description: Economic partnership agreement that entered into force in 2014. Covers goods, services and related economic cooperation with a major regional trade and logistics hub.
candidates.notes: Complements ANZTEC as a core high-quality bilateral instrument.

candidates.title: Taiwan’s FTA / ECA network overview
candidates.publisher: Office of Trade Negotiations / related agencies
candidates.description: Overview of Taiwan’s free-trade and economic-cooperation agreements in force (Panama, Guatemala, ECFA, New Zealand/ANZTEC, Singapore/ASTEP, Paraguay, Eswatini, Belize, and others). Constrained by diplomatic status but still forms a coherent network that structures preferential trade.
referenced_by: Individual FTA legal texts and utilisation reports
Customs trade statistics by preferential partner
candidates.notes: Meta-node that situates ECFA, ANZTEC, ASTEP and the Latin-American agreements. Parallel to the Korea FTA-network node. Helps the force layout form a coherent external-trade cluster.

candidates.title: Population Projections
candidates.description: Official long-term population projections under alternative fertility, mortality and migration scenarios. Show continued population decline and rapid rise in old-age dependency under current ultra-low fertility.
referenced_by: Education, labour-supply and pension planning documents
candidates.notes: Forward-looking demographic node that inherits strong edges from vital statistics and super-aged indicators.

candidates.title: Export Orders statistics
candidates.description: Monthly statistics on export orders received by Taiwanese firms, broken down by product and destination. Leading indicator for industrial production and merchandise exports, especially in electronics.
referenced_by: Customs export statistics and short-term forecasting
candidates.notes: High-frequency leading indicator tightly coupled to the semiconductor/electronics cycle. Strengthens short-term activity edges.

candidates.title: Science Park / Hsinchu and related high-tech cluster statistics
candidates.publisher: National Science and Technology Council / Science Park administrations / DGBAS-related
candidates.region: Taiwan (Hsinchu, Southern, Central Science Parks etc.)
candidates.description: Statistics on employment, sales, investment and firm counts in Taiwan’s major science parks — the geographic concentration points of the semiconductor and high-tech industries.
referenced_by: Industrial production and export performance analysis
candidates.notes: Spatial uniqueness node. Hsinchu and the other science parks are the physical loci of Taiwan’s foundry and design strength; they create regional-contrast and cluster edges.
